name: SAMPLE — Welcome 10% Off
rule: Applies a 10% discount to the subtotal on a customer's first order.
eligibility: First-time customers only, one use per customer
note: SAMPLE PROMOTION — for development/testing only. This is not a real, currently offered PAL Café promotion.

name: SAMPLE — Free Fries with Burger
rule: A free order of French Fries is added when any burger-category item is in the order.
eligibility: Order must contain at least one item from the burger category
note: SAMPLE PROMOTION — inactive by default. This is not a real, currently offered PAL Café promotion.

name: SAMPLE — Delivery Fee Waived Over AED 100
rule: Waives the delivery fee when the order subtotal is AED 100 or more and order_type is delivery.
note: SAMPLE PROMOTION — for development/testing only. This is not a real, currently offered PAL Café promotion.
